repos.description: :books: 免费的计算机编程类中文书籍，欢迎投稿
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是免费的中文编程书籍索引库，涵盖操作系统、Web开发、算法、大数据等语言无关和语言相关的计算机技术书籍，提供高质量的学习资源集合，支持社区投稿与更新，助力程序员技能提升。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a curated collection of free Chinese programming books covering computer science fundamentals, web development, algorithms, and major programming languages, serving as a valuable learning resource for developers with community-driven contributions.

repos.description:  This project is dedicated to collecting high-quality macOS software and organizing them systematically by different categories for easy search and use.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome Mac 是一个精选 macOS 优质软件的资源库，涵盖开发工具、设计软件、效率应用等多个类别。项目规模庞大，支持多语言（含中文、韩文），并提供 Docker 镜像和 npm 包形式发布。包含开源、免费、App Store 应用等标签分类，鼓励用户贡献与反馈。
repos.summary_en: Awesome Mac is a curated collection of premium macOS software across categories like development tools, design apps, and productivity utilities. It features a vast scale, multilingual support (including Chinese and Korean), and is available via Docker and npm. The list categorizes apps by open-source, freeware, and App Store status, encouraging community contributions.

repos.description: 🐹 Keep your Mac clean, light, and running like new. Fast open-source CLI, plus a native Mac app.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: 🚀 Awesome list of open source applications for macOS. https://t.me/s/opensourcemacosapps
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是 macOS 开源应用精选列表，收录 689 款高质量开源应用，涵盖音频、开发、图形、生产力等 49 个类别。以 Swift 为主力语言，支持跨平台与原生应用，旨在帮助用户发现优质免费工具并鼓励社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 689 open source macOS applications across 49 categories, including audio, development, graphics, and productivity. Primarily written in Swift, it features both native and cross-platform apps to help users discover free tools and encourages community contributions.

repos.description: Next Generation of ShadowsocksX
repos.summary_zh: ShadowsocksX-NG 是 ShadowsocksX 的下一代 macOS 客户端，采用 Swift 重写 GUI 并集成 shadowsocks-libev 的 ss-local 组件。支持 SIP003 插件、AEAD 加密、PAC 自动更新及二维码分享服务器配置，提供手动代理模式以兼容其他应用。通过 launchd 后台运行 ss-local，提升稳定性并简化依赖管理。
repos.summary_en: ShadowsocksX-NG is the next-generation macOS client for Shadowsocks, rebuilt with Swift and integrated with ss-local from shadowsocks-libev. It supports SIP003 plugins, AEAD ciphers, PAC auto-updates, QR code sharing, and manual proxy mode. By running ss-local as a background service via launchd, it improves stability and simplifies dependency management.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具箱，旨在替代多个付费系统工具。它集成了应用独立音量调节、系统资源监控、窗口切换、剪贴板历史、文件暂存架及应用卸载等十余项功能。所有功能均本地运行，无需账户或订阅，通过单一图标即可访问，极大提升了 Mac 用户的操作效率。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit designed to replace a stack of paid utilities. It integrates over a dozen features including per-app volume mixing, system monitoring, window switching, clipboard history, and app uninstallation. Running entirely locally with no accounts or subscriptions, it consolidates multiple tools into a single, efficient menu bar icon.

repos.description: A plugin for Mac WeChat
repos.summary_zh: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac 是一款专为 macOS 设计的微信插件，支持多开、免认证登录、消息撤回同步、自定义回复及AI自动回复等功能。集成迷离/黑夜/上帝/少女等主题皮肤，适配微信3.1.2+，兼容企业微信与简版助手，提供跨平台消息转发与小程序详情展示，是Objective-C生态中广受欢迎的自动化工具之一。
repos.summary_en: MustangYM/WeChatExtension-ForMac is a macOS plugin for WeChat that enables multi-account login, message recall sync, custom replies, and AI auto-reply. It supports themes like Mysterious/Dark/God/Daughter modes, integrates with WeChat 3.1.2+, and offers features like message forwarding, mini-program details, and cross-device notifications. A popular Objective-C project with enterprise and lightweight versions.

repos.description: Show usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code, without having to login.
repos.summary_zh: CodexBar 是一款 macOS 14+ 菜单栏应用，实时显示 OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等主流 AI 服务的令牌/额度使用情况（会话+周额度），支持多提供商独立或合并显示，无需登录即可查看窗口重置时间，提供本地成本扫描与状态监控功能。
repos.summary_en: CodexBar is a tiny macOS 14+ menu bar app that displays token/credit usage (session + weekly) for OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and other AI providers without requiring login. It supports per-provider toggles, merge icons mode, local cost scanning, and real-time reset countdowns via a compact two-bar meter icon.

repos.description: Apple TV Aerial Screensaver for Mac
repos.summary_zh: Aerial 是一款 macOS 屏保程序，基于 Apple TV 的 Aerial 系列航拍视频，展示纽约、旧金山、夏威夷、中国等地的壮丽景色。支持多语言地理特征标注、实时天气与预报，开源协作，兼容 Apple Silicon。
repos.summary_en: Aerial is a macOS screensaver featuring Apple's Aerial video collection, showcasing aerial views of locations like New York, San Francisco, and Hawaii. It supports multilingual overlays, real-time weather data, and is open-source with community contributions.

repos.description: Swift Featured Projects in brain Mapping
repos.summary_zh: 本项目精选 Swift 开源项目，聚焦应用架构与思维导图形式呈现，涵盖主流开发工具、框架及实践案例，助力开发者快速掌握 Swift 生态。内容持续更新，强调项目影响力、可持续性与实用性，适合中高级开发者参考。
repos.summary_en: This project curates high-quality Swift open-source projects with a focus on application architecture and mind maps. It covers frameworks, tools, and best practices, providing a structured reference for Swift developers. Content emphasizes influence, sustainability, and practicality, targeting intermediate to advanced developers.

repos.description: Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
repos.summary_zh: Vorssaint 是一款免费开源的 macOS 菜单栏工具集，以单一图标整合音量混音、系统监控、窗口管理、剪贴板历史、文本片段等多项实用功能。模块化设计支持按需安装卸载，零账户、零遥测、零订阅，专为用户隐私和性能效率而构建。
repos.summary_en: Vorssaint is a free, open-source macOS menu bar toolkit that consolidates volume mixing, system monitoring, window management, clipboard history, and more into a single lightweight icon. Fully modular, privacy-first with zero telemetry or subscriptions, and requires macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon.

repos.description: The open source menu bar manager
repos.summary_zh: Thaw 是一款专为 macOS 设计的菜单栏管理工具，支持 macOS 26+。它提供直观的界面帮助用户整理、隐藏和管理菜单栏图标，提升桌面整洁度与工作效率。项目已通过 OpenSSF 安全认证，支持 20 种语言，拥有活跃的 Discord 社区。
repos.summary_en: Thaw is a menu bar manager for macOS, supporting macOS 26+. It helps users organize, hide, and manage menu bar icons with an intuitive interface, improving desktop cleanliness and productivity. The project has achieved OpenSSF security certification, supports 20 languages, and maintains an active Discord community.

repos.description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.
repos.summary_zh: ipatool 是一款跨平台命令行工具，支持从 App Store 搜索并下载 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用的 IPA 包。提供认证、搜索、授权获取、版本管理等核心功能，适用于开发者自动化部署、企业级应用分发及批量下载场景。
repos.summary_en: ipatool is a cross-platform command-line tool for searching and downloading iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS app packages (IPA) from the App Store. It supports authentication, search, license acquisition, and version management, ideal for developer workflows, enterprise distribution, and batch app management.

repos.description: Mac Mouse Fix - Make Your $10 Mouse Better Than an Apple Trackpad!
repos.summary_zh: Mac Mouse Fix 是一款 macOS 系统增强工具，通过强大的手势识别与按键自定义功能，将普通鼠标的体验提升至超越 Apple 触控板的水平。它支持平滑滚动、应用切换等高级手势，并兼容罗技等主流鼠标，提供媲美原生触控板的流畅交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Mac Mouse Fix is a macOS utility that enhances any mouse with advanced gestures and customizable buttons, delivering a user experience surpassing Apple Trackpads. It enables smooth scrolling, app switching, and intuitive controls, making budget mice as efficient as premium trackpads or Logitech MX Master.

repos.description: iOS interview questions;iOS面试题集锦（附答案）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统整理了iOS开发面试中的核心知识点，涵盖Objective-C和Swift两大技术栈，包含55道经典面试题及详细参考答案，重点涉及内存管理、多线程、Runtime机制、KVC/KVO、Block等底层原理，并提供理论篇与实践篇双版本解析，是iOS开发者求职与技能提升的权威参考资料。
repos.summary_en: This repository compiles 55 essential iOS interview questions with comprehensive answers in both Objective-C and Swift, covering core topics like memory management, multithreading, Runtime mechanisms, KVC/KVO, and Blocks. It includes theoretical and practical sections, serving as a definitive resource for iOS developers preparing for technical interviews and deepening their understanding of system-level concepts.

repos.description: 1 script run the vphone
repos.summary_zh: 一键脚本在 macOS 上通过 Tart 虚拟机运行已越狱的 iOS 26.1 环境（vphone），内置完整 bootstrap 和 APT 源。只需一条命令即可启动，支持 VNC 远程连接桌面，适合测试、开发验证及研究用途。
repos.summary_en: A one-script solution to run a pre-jailbroken iOS 26.1 virtual iPhone via Tart VM on macOS, with full bootstrap and APT packages included. Launch with a single command and connect via VNC. Ideal for iOS development, testing, and research.

repos.description: 30 days of React Native demos
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是30天React Native实战教程，涵盖从基础组件到高级动画、手势识别、地图定位、生物识别等22个完整案例，包含iOS原生级交互效果，适合移动端开发学习者系统掌握React Native核心技能。
repos.summary_en: This project is a 30-day React Native tutorial series featuring 22 complete demos, covering core components, animations, gestures, maps, biometric authentication, and more. It provides hands-on experience with iOS-level interactions for mobile development learners.

repos.description: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React
repos.summary_zh: Liquid Glass React 是一款为 React 应用打造的 Apple 液态玻璃特效组件库，完美复现 macOS 和 iOS 中的毛玻璃视觉效果。支持多模式折射、弹性交互、鼠标追踪位移、色差调节等高级特性，适用于现代 UI 设计中的卡片、按钮等组件，显著提升视觉质感与交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Liquid Glass React is a React component library that replicates Apple's Liquid Glass effect, delivering authentic frosted glass visuals with displacement, refraction, and elastic interactions. It supports multiple refraction modes, mouse tracking, chromatic aberration, and customizable blur/saturation, ideal for modern UI elements like cards and buttons.

repos.description: Free and open source database client built natively for developers
repos.summary_zh: TablePro 是一款面向开发者的免费开源原生数据库客户端，支持 macOS、iOS 和 Linux。它摒弃 Electron 和 JVM，采用原生框架构建，冷启动低于 1 秒，内存占用约 80MB。支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis 等主流 SQL/NoSQL 数据库，内置 AI 功能（聊天、代码建议、MCP 服务），并可通过插件扩展。提供 SQL 编辑器、数据网格、SSH 隧道、iCloud 同步等核心功能，是 TablePlus 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: TablePro is a free, open-source native database client for developers, built without Electron or JVM. It supports major SQL and NoSQL databases with native drivers, cold starts under 1 second, and ~80MB RAM usage. Features include an AI-powered SQL editor, data grid, SSH tunnels, iCloud sync, and plugin extensibility. It serves as an open-source alternative to TablePlus with integrated AI chat, MCP server, and cross-platform support.

repos.description: Intelligent adaptive brightness for your external monitors
repos.summary_zh: Lunar 是一款专为 macOS 设计的显示器控制应用，支持通过 DDC/CI 协议直接调节外接显示器亮度、音量、输入源及屏幕方向。其核心亮点包括传感器/同步/位置自适应亮度调节、XDR/HDR 高亮度支持、低于 0% 的暗光模式、App 预设配置及 BlackOut 功能（关闭屏幕同时保留充电、音频等功能），完美兼容 Intel 与 Apple Silicon 芯片。
repos.summary_en: Lunar is a macOS app for controlling external monitors via DDC/CI, enabling hardware-level brightness, volume, input switching, and orientation adjustments. Key features include sensor/sync/location-based adaptive brightness, support for 1000–1600 nits XDR/HDR displays, sub-zero dimming, app-specific presets, and BlackOut mode—preserving charging, audio, and input while turning off screens. Fully compatible with both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.

repos.description: Enable Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China with SIP enabled, for version between  MacOS 15.4.1+ and 26.5 beta3
repos.summary_zh: 本工具通过修改系统缓存文件及注入eligibiltyd进程，绕过Apple对Apple Intelligence在中国销售Mac上的区域限制，支持macOS 15.4+及26.1+，无需常驻后台服务。提供方法1（lldb注入+文件锁定）和方法2（直接修改plist）两种方案，新增强制修改地区为美国功能以解锁ChatGPT整合等高级特性，适用于M1及以上芯片设备。
repos.summary_en: This tool enables Apple Intelligence on Macs sold in Mainland China by bypassing regional restrictions via system cache modification and eligibilityd process injection, tested on macOS 15.4+ and 26.1+. It requires no persistent background services and offers two methods: Method 1 (lldb injection + file locking) and Method 2 (direct plist editing), with an added option to force region change to US for advanced features like ChatGPT integration, compatible with M1+ chips.

repos.description: Remote Control for Codex.
repos.summary_zh: Remodex 是一款本地优先的开源桥接工具，结合 iOS 应用与 macOS 后台服务，实现 iPhone 对 OpenAI Codex 的远程控制。支持端到端加密配对、实时流式交互、Git 操作、子智能体调用及结构化规划模式，提供低延迟响应与细粒度访问控制，全程无需依赖公共服务器。
repos.summary_en: Remodex is a local-first open-source bridge with an iOS app that enables remote control of OpenAI Codex from your iPhone. It features end-to-end encrypted pairing, real-time streaming, Git actions, subagents, planning mode, and secure access controls—all running on-device without relying on public endpoints.

repos.description: An unofficial 12306 Client for Mac
repos.summary_zh: 12306ForMac 是一款非官方的 Mac 版 12306 火车票订票助手，支持自动捡票与下单功能。基于 Swift 开发，依赖 Carthage 管理 CocoaPods 依赖，兼容 OS X 10.11 及以上系统。项目采用 Alamofire、PromiseKit 等主流框架，提供图形化界面替代官方网页购票，适用于 macOS 用户便捷购票。
repos.summary_en: 12306ForMac is an unofficial macOS client for 12306 railway ticket booking, supporting auto-search and purchasing. Built with Swift 3.2 and Xcode 9.0, it uses Carthage for dependency management and integrates Alamofire, PromiseKit, and FMDB. Designed for OS X 10.11+, it offers a native GUI alternative to the official web interface for convenient ticket booking.

repos.summary_zh: Yetone语音输入是一款macOS菜单栏语音输入应用，支持按住Fn键录音、实时流式语音识别（Apple Speech框架），自动注入文本到当前焦点输入框。具备CJK输入法兼容处理、多语言切换、动态波形动画浮窗、LLM后处理纠错等功能，采用Swift开发，提供Makefile构建脚本。
repos.summary_en: Yetone Voice Input is a macOS menu-bar app enabling voice input via Fn key hold/release. It features real-time streaming speech recognition (Apple Speech), text injection with CJK IME compatibility, animated waveform floating window, multi-language support, and optional LLM-based transcription refinement via OpenAI-compatible API.

repos.description: worktree coding agents command center.
repos.summary_zh: Supacode 是一个原生终端编码智能体指挥中心，专为 macOS 设计。它采用 Swift Composable Architecture 构建，集成 libghostty 实现高性能终端交互，支持通过 mise 管理依赖，提供完整的开发、测试与格式化工具链，致力于提升终端环境下的 AI 辅助编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Supacode is a native terminal coding agent command center for macOS, built with Swift Composable Architecture and integrated with libghostty for high-performance terminal interaction. It supports dependency management via mise and offers a full development workflow including build, test, and formatting tools, focusing on enhancing AI-assisted programming in the terminal environment.

repos.description: A beautiful screenshot + screen recording + Loom alternative - all native, self hostable and free.
repos.summary_zh: Screendrop 是一款 macOS 原生免费开源的截图与屏幕录制工具，作为 Loom 的自托管替代方案。支持全屏/窗口/区域捕获、视频转录、字幕生成、画中画剪辑，并通过 Cloudflare 实现带搜索与评论功能的链接分享，深度集成 Apple Shortcuts 与 Siri 自动化。
repos.summary_en: Screendrop is a free, native macOS screenshot and screen recording app — an open-source, self-hostable Loom alternative. Features include AI on-device transcription, karaoke captions, video editing with zooms and picture-in-picture, smart redaction, and shareable links with searchable transcripts and comments via Cloudflare. Integrates with Apple Shortcuts, Siri, and Finder for seamless automation.

repos.description: 📦 A macOS utility to seamlessly migrate applications to external storage and reclaim local disk space.【一款 macOS 工具，无缝迁移应用到外部存储并自动建立链接，释放宝贵的本地空间】
repos.summary_zh: AppPorts 是一款专为 macOS 设计的应用迁移工具，可将大型应用一键移至外部存储（SSD/SD卡/NAS），并在原位保留极小的启动桩，实现无快捷箭头、无缝启动。具备自动更新保护、代码签名修复、孤立链接检测及数据目录迁移功能，有效解决 Mac 本地空间不足问题。
repos.summary_en: AppPorts is a macOS utility for seamlessly migrating large applications to external storage (SSD/SD card/NAS) while leaving a tiny launcher stub locally. It features arrow-free linking, auto-update protection, code signature repair, and orphaned link detection, effectively reclaiming precious local disk space without breaking system integration.

repos.description: Every display control macOS hides, in one menu bar app: sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness and volume, Extra Brightness past 100%, presets, virtual displays. Free and open source, a no-cost alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar.
repos.summary_zh: Crisp是免费开源的macOS外接显示器控制面板，提供锐利HiDPI缩放、DDC亮度调节、显示器预设与虚拟屏幕等功能，替代BetterDisplay等付费工具，提升多屏显示体验。
repos.summary_en: Crisp is a free, open-source external monitor control app for macOS, offering sharp HiDPI scaling, DDC brightness control, display presets and virtual displays as an alternative to paid tools like BetterDisplay.

repos.description: Google Assistant for macOS!
repos.summary_zh: MacAssistant 是一款将 Google Assistant 集成到 macOS 的 Swift 应用，支持语音交互与系统控制。通过 Google Assistant SDK 实现自然语言处理，支持天气查询、日程管理等常见指令，需用户自行配置 OAuth 凭证。项目采用 Swift 4.2 开发，基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers，提供跨平台语音助手解决方案。
repos.summary_en: MacAssistant is a Swift-based macOS app integrating Google Assistant via the Google Assistant SDK, enabling voice interaction and system control. It supports natural language queries like weather and agenda, requiring user-provided OAuth credentials. Built with Swift 4.2, gRPC, and Protocol Buffers, it offers a cross-platform voice assistant solution for macOS.

repos.description: Native GUI for Homebrew Casks
repos.summary_zh: CaskHub 是 Homebrew Casks 的原生 macOS 图形界面应用，支持浏览、搜索、安装、更新和卸载 Mac 应用。采用 SwiftUI 构建，提供分类导航、排行榜、一键 Adopt 非 Homebrew 应用等功能，完全免费开源，无广告订阅。
repos.summary_en: CaskHub is a native macOS GUI for Homebrew Casks, enabling browsing, searching, installing, updating, and uninstalling Mac apps. Built with SwiftUI, it features category browsing, popularity charts, one-click app adoption, and is 100% free and open source with no ads or subscriptions.

repos.description: This is a Opensource Live wallpaper solution for MacOS
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为 macOS 14+ 设计的开源动态壁纸应用，支持 MP4 和 MOV 视频格式，具备多显示器支持与高性能渲染。用户可通过 Homebrew 或源码编译安装，需注意绕过 Gatekeeper 安全限制。项目计划将 Objective-C++ UI 迁移至 SwiftUI，但守护进程保持不变。
repos.summary_en: An open-source live wallpaper app for macOS 14+, supporting MP4/MOV video playback with multi-display rendering and high performance. Install via Homebrew or compile from source using Xcode and CMake. Requires Gatekeeper bypass for unsigned apps. UI modernization to SwiftUI is planned while maintaining the daemon component.

repos.description: A calm menu bar, done the native way. Hides the icons you don't need until you do.
repos.summary_zh: Pelmet 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏管理工具，专为 macOS 27 重新设计的菜单栏打造。它可将不常用图标自动隐藏，通过悬停、点击或快捷键优雅恢复显示，支持可视化布局编辑器与三区域分组管理，免费开源无账号要求。
repos.summary_en: Pelmet is an open-source macOS menu bar manager designed for the redesigned menu bar in macOS 27. It auto-hides unused icons and elegantly reveals them via hover, click, or shortcuts, featuring a visual layout editor with three-zone grouping. Free, native, no account needed.

repos.description: Clash X
repos.summary_zh: ClashX 是一款基于 Clash 的 macOS 代理客户端，专为 macOS 15+ (Sequoia) 优化，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、SOCKS 协议及 Vmess/Shadowsocks/Trojan 等多种代理协议。提供直观的图形界面与 Surge 风格配置，集成 GeoIP 规则、Netfilter TCP 重定向等功能，适用于高级网络代理需求。
repos.summary_en: ClashX is a rule-based proxy client for macOS built on Clash, optimized for macOS 15+ (Sequoia). It supports HTTP/HTTPS, SOCKS protocols and multiple proxy types including Vmess, Shadowsocks, and Trojan. Features intuitive UI, Surge-like configuration, GeoIP rules, Netfilter TCP redirection, and advanced scripting capabilities.

repos.description: Beautiful native macOS download manager for direct links, magnets, and torrents.
repos.summary_zh: Harbor是一款原生macOS下载管理器，基于SwiftUI构建，支持直链、磁力链接与种子文件下载。主打本地优先、隐私友好设计，提供批量添加、流量控制、Torrent预览等实用功能，完美契合Mac原生工作流。
repos.summary_en: Harbor is a beautiful native macOS download manager built with SwiftUI, supporting direct links, magnet links, and torrents. Local-first, privacy-friendly, and free, it offers batch queuing, traffic profiles, and Torrent preview for a seamless Mac-native experience.

repos.description: A native macOS menu-bar app that keeps your keyboard input source locked — global, per-app, and per-URL.
repos.summary_zh: LockIME 是一款原生 macOS 菜单栏应用，专注于解决多输入法切换混乱问题。它支持全局、按应用及按浏览器 URL 锁定键盘输入源，一旦检测到输入法被切换，立即自动恢复。基于 Swift 6 和 Liquid Glass 技术构建，提供灵活的规则匹配与快捷键控制，显著提升多语言用户的输入效率。
repos.summary_en: LockIME is a native macOS menu-bar utility that locks your keyboard input source globally, per-app, or per-URL. It instantly reverts any unauthorized input method switches, ensuring a consistent typing experience. Built with Swift 6 and Liquid Glass, it offers flexible rule matching and global shortcuts for power users.

repos.description: The unofficial V2EX app for iOS
repos.summary_zh: darkerk/v2ex 是一款专为 iOS 平台开发的非官方 V2EX 客户端应用，采用 Swift 4.1 编写，支持 iOS 10.0+。该应用提供简洁的界面设计，让用户能够便捷地浏览 V2EX 社区内容，包括节点、主题和评论等核心功能，是 V2EX 用户的移动端优质替代方案。
repos.summary_en: darkerk/v2ex is an unofficial iOS app for V2EX, built with Swift 4.1 and compatible with iOS 10.0+. It offers a clean interface for browsing V2EX content, including nodes, topics, and comments, serving as a convenient mobile alternative to the web version of V2EX.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: Independent iOS client for Lody — native chat, sessions, and coding-agent collaboration on iPhone
repos.summary_zh: 独立开源 iOS 客户端，为 Lody AI 协作平台打造。采用 React Native + Swift 6.0 混合架构，结合 CRDT 数据同步，支持无限聊天、流式文本渲染、代码 Diff 高亮与文件树导航，严格遵循 Apple HIG，提供安全的本地会话与远程服务桥接体验。
repos.summary_en: Independent open-source iOS client for Lody AI platform. Hybrid React Native + Swift 6.0 architecture with CRDT sync (Loro/Flock). Features infinite chat, streaming rendering, code diff highlighting, and file tree. Strictly follows Apple HIG for authentic native experience bridging local sessions and remote services.

repos.description: Beans Music - iOS 26 液态玻璃风格第三方音乐播放器（仅供学习）
repos.summary_zh: 基于 SwiftUI 构建的 iOS 第三方音乐播放器，采用 iOS 26 液态玻璃设计语言，聚合网易云音乐与 QQ 音乐双平台数据。支持歌词深度定制、动态封面取色、自由布局调整及一键备份，提供沉浸式本地化体验。
repos.summary_en: A SwiftUI-based third-party iOS music player featuring iOS 26 Liquid Glass design. Aggregates NetEase Cloud Music and QQ Music with deep lyric customization, dynamic cover color extraction, free layout adjustment, and one-click backup for an immersive localized experience.

repos.description: A tiny macOS menu bar app that tracks your dev servers across projects.
repos.summary_zh: Port Menu 是一款轻量级 macOS 菜单栏应用，专为开发者设计，用于自动追踪跨项目的本地开发服务器。它能实时扫描并展示 Git 仓库名、分支、端口及运行时长，支持一键打开浏览器、复制 URL 或终止进程，无需任何配置即可实现 localhost 服务的可视化管理。
repos.summary_en: Port Menu is a lightweight macOS menu bar app designed for developers to automatically track local development servers across projects. It scans running processes to display Git repo names, branches, ports, and uptime. With zero configuration, it enables one-click access to open in browser, copy URLs, or kill processes directly from the menu bar.

repos.description: A native macOS workspace terminal organized around Projects and Worktrees, powered by tmux and libghostty
repos.summary_zh: Mori 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生终端工作空间管理工具，围绕 Git 项目的 Worktree 构建，通过 tmux 实现持久化会话管理，并集成 libghostty 提供 GPU 加速的终端渲染。支持本地与远程仓库、项目级导航、独立分支会话及 SwiftUI 侧边栏交互，提供类 IDE 的高效开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Mori is a native macOS terminal workspace manager centered on Projects and Git Worktrees, powered by tmux for persistent sessions and libghostty for GPU-accelerated terminal rendering. It enables project-first navigation, local/remote repo support, independent branch sessions, and a SwiftUI sidebar interface, delivering an IDE-like development workflow.

repos.description: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
repos.summary_zh: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

repos.description: ClashFX — macOS proxy tool with Enhanced Mode (TUN)
repos.summary_zh: ClashFX 是一款基于 mihomo 核心的 macOS 代理工具，支持 TUN 模式实现全局流量捕获，提供规则路由、多协议代理（VMess/VLESS/Trojan 等）、DNS 安全及 Apple Silicon 原生支持，适用于高级网络代理与隐私保护场景。
repos.summary_en: ClashFX is a macOS proxy client powered by the mihomo core, featuring TUN-based Enhanced Mode for system-wide traffic capture, rule-based routing, support for multiple protocols (VMess/VLESS/Trojan/Shadowsocks/Hysteria2), secure DNS with Fake-IP, and native Apple Silicon compatibility.

repos.description: A local macOS desktop matting tool built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust.
repos.summary_zh: Apple Matting 是一款基于 Tauri、Vue 和 Rust 开发的本地 macOS 桌面背景抠图工具，支持单张及批量图片处理，兼容 JPG/PNG/WEBP/BMP 格式，提供实时预览、透明/纯色/渐变背景替换及编辑修正功能，集成中文/英文双语界面。
repos.summary_en: Apple Matting is a local macOS desktop background removal tool built with Tauri, Vue, and Rust. It supports single and batch image processing, offers real-time preview, transparent/solid-color/gradient backgrounds, and includes a bilingual UI (Chinese/English) with editing refinements.

repos.description: Awesome open-source macOS applications
repos.summary_zh: 自动聚合GitHub星标仓库，构建macOS开源应用 browsable 目录。收录281款应用，涵盖AI大模型、开发者工具、系统维护等26个分类，每日自动同步更新，提供免手工维护的macOS生态发现入口。
repos.summary_en: An auto-generated browser curating 281 macOS open-source apps from GitHub stars across 26 categories. Covers AI/LLM, developer tools, productivity, and system utilities. Synced daily with zero manual editing — a hands-off discovery hub for the macOS ecosystem.
